prayer: PRAYER: Criminal Original Petition filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. praying to call for the records in C.C. No. 59/2015 which is pending before the Learned Additional Mahila (Judicial Magistrate) of Tiruchirappalli and pass necessary order to re-investigate the case.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

A.D. Jagadish Chandira, J.:— This petition has been filed seeking direction to call for the records in C.C. No. 59/2015 which is pending before the Learned Additional Mahila (Judicial Magistrate) of Tiruchirappalli and pass necessary order to re-investigate the case.

2. When the matter is taken up for hearing the learned Additional Public Prosecutor would submit that the petitioner had filed petition in Cr.M.P. No. 9930 of 2019 for re-investigation in C.C. No. 59 of 2019 before the Additional Mahila Court (Judicial Magistrate) Tiruchirapalli and the learned Magistrate by an order dated 08.07.2019 dismissed the petition. Against the order of dismissal, the petitioner had earlier preferred revision in Crl.R.C. (MD) No. 729of 2019 and it was dismissed by this Court.

3. In the opinion of the Court only a revision is maintainable against the order passed in Crl.M.P. No. 9930 of 2019 by the Judicial Magistrate.

4. Having approached this Court by way of revision and withdrawn the same the petitioner cannot approach by way of invoking Section 482 of Cr.P.C. In the opinion of the Court, the act of the petitioner amounts to forum shopping. The above petition is not maintainable. Hence, this petition is dismissed. Consequently connected miscellaneous petition is also closed.
